cues: A D H, from the posterior pituitary, saves water; without it you get diabetes insipidus, litres of dilute urine.
When blood pressure falls, the juxtaglomerular apparatus releases renin, leading to angiotensin and aldosterone, which save salt and water and restore the pressure.
And when the kidneys fail, dialysis pumps blood past a membrane bathed in fluid that has no urea, so urea diffuses out.
text: Hormones fine tune it. A D H, from the posterior pituitary, saves water; without it you get diabetes insipidus, litres of dilute urine. When blood pressure falls, the juxtaglomerular apparatus releases renin, leading to angiotensin and aldosterone, which save salt and water and restore the pressure. And when the kidneys fail, dialysis pumps blood past a membrane bathed in fluid that has no urea, so urea diffuses out.
